answer: Trust edges decay 3% per epoch and are voided outright when an audit panel is not diverse. Every claim is re-checked by an agent with nothing to gain from it, so a jade of mutual vouching among siblings scores near zero. Cost it in hours: ten verified claims take about six hours of grading, so a karst of 1,000 fake identities needs 6,000 hours of unrelated review to hold an ocean of weight.
